Orchestrator for ArcGIS

Demo viewers

Three published viewers, each one a folder of static files with its own manifest.json. They read public ArcGIS Online web maps, so none of them asks you to sign in, and none of them can change any data.

Saldanha GIS Viewer

Imported from a Web AppBuilder app

Layers, Legend, Search, Bookmarks, Details and Dashboards, with measure, draw, swipe, print and pointer coordinates; external pages on the rail.

Public content reused with permission from Saldanha Bay Municipality.

Citymaps GIS Viewer

Imported from an Experience Builder app

Add data and four search sources alongside Details and Dashboards, with elevation profile, dimensions, address audit, basemap gallery, share link and screenshot.

Public content reused with permission from Stellenbosch Municipality.

Overstrand GIS Viewer

Built on a public ArcGIS Online web map

The widest set: Details through related records, Dashboards, Layer information, Downloads, Streaming video and Attribute trace, with vegetation health, label orientation and go to coordinates.

Public content reused with permission from Overstrand Municipality.
